proposedBellaRules.scope: Physical visible picture raster from qualified own supported descriptor within accepted legacy OMF/Bento1. Audio inapplicable. No composition/aspect/square-pixel conversion, filename/codec-name/resolutionID size substitute, new TIFF decoder or Bin Filter change.
proposedBellaRules.inputs: Known typed/order-aware own StoredWidth/Height, DisplayWidth/Height/XOffset/YOffset and FrameLayout. Captured legacy geometry Long signed32, LayoutType two-byte; not modern OMF2 unsigned dimensions or MXF wire layout. Coding/ID from accepted Compression context can qualify proxy candidacy.
proposedBellaRules.defaults: OMF Display and Sampled independent relative to Stored. Genuinely absent optional dimensions use Stored, offsets0; retain existing original-toolkit legacy per-field compatibility. Safely complete relevant descriptor/dictionary context must prove absence. Present zero/negative/unreadable/conflicting/bad values do not default.
proposedBellaRules.geometry: Positive sizes, nonnegative offsets and checked Stored-relative containment before height conversion. Ordinary Resolution needs no Sampled decoding; no generic Display-to-Sampled-to-Stored preference ladder or arbitrary standard-size whitelist.
proposedBellaRules.layout: Qualified legacy OMF1 layout1 and existing layout3 double selected per-field height with overflow checks. FullFrame0 and SingleField2 do not double; unknown unsupported. Native internal enum/coordinate normalization and MXF mixed/segmented rules are not transplanted.
proposedBellaRules.proxy: Preserve existing seven exact configurations only: complete coding, resolutionID, three sizes/layout and zero offsets. Read Sampled only when a candidate needs qualification; known ordinary valid Display survives independent Sampled damage. No blanket Stored fallback for an unexplained crop, small raster or H264 family.
proposedBellaRules.retentionAndDisplay: Selected numeric width/height with compact origin/availability as needed; current widthxheight late display/export and numeric pair sort. Audio and unavailable picture blank, physical row/independent valid fields retained. No duplicate formatted row label/raw property graph.
proposedBellaRules.implementation: Small fresh typed OMF adapter/shared ordinary checked geometry functions; explicit MDB/OMF vs MXF coordinate/default adapters. std::optional and fixed-width integers suffice, validated QSize only at int-compatible boundary with positive dimensions checked. No class/parser per column, hierarchy, floating-point/aspect scaling or new dependency.
proposedBellaRules.compressionAndLifetime: Approved Compression stored naming geometry/clock unchanged and separate from visible Resolution. Share needed temporary facts; release rectangles/indexes/bytes when all agreed consumers finish, keep only selected values/required compact context.
proposedBellaRules.otherDecisions: No new file opens, essence decode, source preference/cancel/scheduling decision, native GUI equivalence or measured gain. Final priority/opening rules and general OMF damage handling remain later.

currentSourceBehavior.finding: Own supported physical descriptor technical projection emits no picture Resolution for established audio classes. It does not take geometry from master name or filename. Supported video classes currently share named DIDD geometry acquisition; any narrower native class authority/coverage belongs to native review, not inference from Kind alone.

StoredWidth/StoredHeight and FrameLayout are mandatory usable values. Current decoder honors complete generic numeric type widths and established object order; typical legacy Long is signed32, LayoutType is signed16. Projection integer() uses QVariant numeric conversion without checking each property-specific native type, so acceptance is broader than Bella native typed field authority.

Only layout0..3 enters OMF visible selection. Multiplier2 applies to layout1 and legacy ObjID/OMF1 layout3; otherwise multiplier1. Layout2 is a single field and is not automatically doubled. Layout4 is not accepted by this current legacy route. Presence of ObjID is the current legacy test; Bella can use its already-established wire revision.

Optional Sampled/Display width,height each independently default to Stored and offsets to0 when no matching property exists and the source read is Complete. This deliberately preserves legacy partial-set compatibility. A present unreadable/conflicting/nonconvertible field does not take an absent default; zero/negative dimension is invalid.

OMF Display and Sampled coordinates are independently relative to Stored. displayRelativeToSampled remains false, so ordinary result validates only Display inside Stored; Sampled does not replace absent Display or become required parent. Current caller nevertheless constructs Sampled every time.

Helper checks positive dimensions, nonnegative positions and containment by subtraction, avoiding offset+width overflow. It applies checked height multiplication after selecting a valid display rectangle. Unexplained oversized Display does not silently select Stored.

If ordinary Display does not fit, exactly seven complete proxy patterns can select Stored. Full coding label, exact resolutionID, layout, all three sizes, and zero Sampled/Display offsets are required. Small raster or H264 alone is not proxy proof.

Stored naming geometry and selected visible raster have different consumers. Compression currently receives stored width/frame-height plus its own raw/narrow naming clock, not Resolution label. Cropping/proxy selection must not overwrite those inputs.

Helper result is numeric qint64 width/height+origin, but projection immediately formats WxH; adapter stores QString resolution, table/CSV return same string, sort parses it back into QSize/int. Unknown/inapplicable selection is blank. Current already-read OMF/MXF source preference over MDB is historical behavior, not a new Bella read trigger.

accuracyLimitsAndPotentialSimplification: Current geometry absence uses whole-source Complete, not stronger completeObject dictionary/name/owner enumeration. Bella must establish relevant absence and unsafe ambiguity without claiming current source already universally enforces that stronger policy. No damaged real example was inspected.

Generic numeric decoder honors declared type/width, but projection expected-field type checks are broad. New exact legacy Long4/LayoutType2 field qualification and explicitly supported alternative layouts must be stated; do not guess from bytecount alone or silently import MXF UInt32/UInt8 wire rules.

Do not import MXF nested Sampled-parent geometry/defaults or MXF layout3 height behavior into legacyOMF. Current/approved OMF display-relative-to-Stored and legacy partial per-field defaults are useful compatibility, not bloat.

Ordinary legacy OMF needs Stored, Display and layout only. Sampled can be decoded/looked up only when exact known proxy qualification is needed; malformed Sampled must not manufacture proxy proof. This is selective Bella acquisition around unchanged semantics, not a measured speed improvement.

Current helper computes sampledValid even when OMF ordinary selection does not use it; this is small pure arithmetic, not a demonstrated performance issue or reason for a new abstraction. Small fresh adapter/pure helper is sufficient.

QSize presentation/sort requires explicit positive ranges and int-fit checks. Current formatted width/height can be qint64 while sorting parses int; no actual oversized result or wrong sort demonstrated. A small64-bit numeric pair avoids unnecessary narrowing in Bella.

Actual samples establish layout2 single-field crop, layout1 doubled height and nonzero DisplayYOffset; they do not establish layout3 physical OMF, big-endian, absent/partial/damaged/contradictory/proxy cases. Those are source/spec/authored-test coverage.
No native GUI equivalence, stored encoded/decoded essence proof, MDB/OMF per-file output parity, scanner speed/memory gain, or version support expansion is established.
proposedMinimumBella: Preserve verified existing physical-raster policy with known own typed fields and a small source-specific OMF adapter feeding a value-only selector. No image decode, filename geometry, clip/master scaling or pixel-aspect conversion.

Use proven absent-only Stored/zero defaults, including supported legacy partial sets. Require valid positive Stored/display and safe Stored-relative offsets. Present damaged/conflicting/invalid required values produce no source Resolution rather than zero/default/standard-size repair.

Apply source-qualified accepted layout0..3 multiplier: layout1 and established legacyOMF1 layout3 double selected per-field height, layout0/2 do not. Validate before checked multiplication. Do not apply frame-rate/interlace-name heuristics.

Preserve all seven exact proxy exceptions; retrieve Sampled and full coding/resolution context only where needed, and do not turn unexplained crop contradictions into Stored fallback. If no exception qualifies, leave Resolution unavailable.

Retain numeric selected width/height with compact origin/availability, format WxH for table/CSV and sort numbers. Release raw rectangle/property graph after consumers; preserve transient stored geometry separately for unchanged Compression names. QSize is optional only at checked int-safe Qt boundary.

No new helper hierarchy, per-column class, dependency, permanent formatted duplicate or candidate graph. Existing geometry arithmetic is already compact and useful. No source-priority/header-open/Duration/FrameRate/Compression naming/BinFilter/cutover changes.

"""Curate pending OMF Resolution review; reuse-only metadata, no media/app reads."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess

ROOT = Path('/Users/martymclean/Developer/MediaMuster')
CACHE = {}
verified, unavailable, captures = {}, [], {}


def sha(path):
    p = Path(path)
    if str(p) not in CACHE:
        h = hashlib.sha256()
        with p.open('rb') as stream:
            for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
                h.update(block)
        CACHE[str(p)] = h.hexdigest()
    return CACHE[str(p)]


def record(path):
    p = Path(path)
    return {'path': str(p), 'bytes': p.stat().st_size, 'sha256': sha(p)}


def check(path, expected, context):
    p = Path(path)
    if not p.is_absolute():
        p = ROOT / p
    if not p.is_file():
        unavailable.append({'path': str(p), 'expectedSha256': expected, 'context': context})
        return
    actual = sha(p)
    assert actual == expected, (str(p), expected, actual, context)
    verified[str(p)] = {'bytes': p.stat().st_size, 'sha256': actual}
    if str(p).startswith('/private/tmp/') and p.suffix == '.txt' and p.stat().st_size <= 200000:
        captures[str(p)] = {'sha256': actual, 'text': p.read_text()}


def walk(value, context):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for pk, hk in [('path', 'sha256'), ('artifact', 'artifactSha256'),
                       ('resolvedArtifact', 'resolvedArtifactSha256')]:
            if isinstance(value.get(pk), str) and isinstance(value.get(hk), str):
                check(value[pk], value[hk], context)
        for key, child in value.items():
            if context == 'current' and key == 'sourceAnchors':
                continue  # Excerpt hashes are checked separately below.
            walk(child, context + '/' + str(key))
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        for index, child in enumerate(value):
            walk(child, context + '/' + str(index))


expected_receipts = {
    'mc': '8e3c9797c754bf30a1adcb5647a5d858b9b84809fc55e497b5b35bc5869c679c',
    'mdvx': '9f763577ecc00c5e8c825b471f124bd076dc61fc938e6e2c203149c93bc75b49',
    'current': '105d15ba84e5566ff60569a6f3c75a3cc0d80eb719b6cd27ee21e4a37ba2a8dd',
}
receipts, receipt_files = {}, {}
for who, expected in expected_receipts.items():
    p = Path(f'/private/tmp/bella-omf-resolution-{who}-20261025/findings.json')
    assert sha(p) == expected
    receipts[who] = json.loads(p.read_text())
    receipt_files[who] = record(p)
    walk(receipts[who], who)

current = receipts['current']
assert len(current['sourceInputs']) == 12 and len(current['sourceAnchors']) == 28
for source in current['sourceInputs']:
    p = Path(source['path'])
    relative = str(p.relative_to(ROOT))
    assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:' + relative], cwd=ROOT) == p.read_bytes()
for anchor in current['sourceAnchors']:
    lines = Path(anchor['path']).read_text().splitlines(keepends=True)
    text = ''.join(lines[anchor['startLine'] - 1:anchor['endLine']])
    assert text == anchor['text']
    assert hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest() == anchor['sha256']

mdvx = receipts['mdvx']
ranges = []
assert not mdvx['freshFunctions']
with Path(mdvx['binary']['path']).open('rb') as stream:
    for method in mdvx['reusedFunctions']:
        stream.seek(method['binaryOffset'])
        raw = stream.read(method['codeBytes'])
        assert len(raw) == method['codeBytes']
        assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == method['codeSha256']
        ranges.append({k: method[k] for k in ['symbol', 'binaryOffset', 'codeBytes', 'codeSha256']})
assert len(ranges) == 11
assert receipts['mc']['method']['freshDisassembly'] is False
assert len(receipts['mc']['reusedRawFreshlyHashed']) == 13

examples = current['reusedActualExamples']['examples']
assert len(examples) == 5
numeric_checks = []
for example in examples:
    assert example['freshMediaReadThisReview'] is False
    props = example['rawSelectedOwnGeometry']
    if not props:
        assert example['descriptorClass'] in ['WAVD', 'AIFD']
        assert example['illustrativeSelectedNumericRaster'] is None
        continue
    assert len(props) == 11
    values = {}
    for p in props:
        assert p['object'] == example['descriptorObject']
        key = p['propertyName'].removeprefix('OMFI:DIDD:')
        if key == 'FrameLayout':
            assert p['typeName'] == 'omfi:LayoutType' and p['length'] == 2
        else:
            assert p['typeName'] == 'omfi:Long' and p['length'] == 4
        values[key] = int.from_bytes(bytes.fromhex(p['hex']), 'little', signed=True)
    assert values == example['decodedValues']
    sw, sh, dw, dh = (values[k] for k in ['StoredWidth', 'StoredHeight', 'DisplayWidth', 'DisplayHeight'])
    dx, dy, layout = (values[k] for k in ['DisplayXOffset', 'DisplayYOffset', 'FrameLayout'])
    assert sw > 0 and sh > 0 and dw > 0 and dh > 0 and dx >= 0 and dy >= 0
    assert dw <= sw and dh <= sh and dx <= sw - dw and dy <= sh - dh
    multiplier = 2 if layout in [1, 3] else 1
    selected = [dw, dh * multiplier]
    assert selected == example['illustrativeSelectedNumericRaster']
    numeric_checks.append({'path': example['path'], 'ownDescriptor': example['descriptorObject'],
                           'stored': [sw, sh], 'display': [dw, dh], 'displayOffset': [dx, dy],
                           'legacyLayout': layout, 'heightMultiplier': multiplier,
                           'selectedNumericRaster': selected, 'basis': 'Saved byte interpretation only; no parser/app execution.'})
assert [v['selectedNumericRaster'] for v in numeric_checks] == [[288, 243], [1920, 1080], [720, 576]]

historical = [v for v in unavailable if v['context'].startswith('mc/historicalRawReferences/')]
fresh_unavailable = [v for v in unavailable if v not in historical]
assert not fresh_unavailable, fresh_unavailable
approval_path = ROOT / 'Project Bella/evidence/omf-compression-plan-2026-10-25.json'
approval = json.loads(approval_path.read_text())
check(approval['researchAtApproval']['path'], approval['researchAtApproval']['sha256'], 'compressionApproval/research')

rules = {
    'status': 'OMF Resolution recommendations awaiting approval; Compression just accepted. No implementation or cutover.',
    'scope': 'Physical visible picture raster from qualified own supported descriptor within accepted legacy OMF/Bento1. Audio inapplicable. No composition/aspect/square-pixel conversion, filename/codec-name/resolutionID size substitute, new TIFF decoder or Bin Filter change.',
    'inputs': 'Known typed/order-aware own StoredWidth/Height, DisplayWidth/Height/XOffset/YOffset and FrameLayout. Captured legacy geometry Long signed32, LayoutType two-byte; not modern OMF2 unsigned dimensions or MXF wire layout. Coding/ID from accepted Compression context can qualify proxy candidacy.',
    'defaults': 'OMF Display and Sampled independent relative to Stored. Genuinely absent optional dimensions use Stored, offsets0; retain existing original-toolkit legacy per-field compatibility. Safely complete relevant descriptor/dictionary context must prove absence. Present zero/negative/unreadable/conflicting/bad values do not default.',
    'geometry': 'Positive sizes, nonnegative offsets and checked Stored-relative containment before height conversion. Ordinary Resolution needs no Sampled decoding; no generic Display-to-Sampled-to-Stored preference ladder or arbitrary standard-size whitelist.',
    'layout': 'Qualified legacy OMF1 layout1 and existing layout3 double selected per-field height with overflow checks. FullFrame0 and SingleField2 do not double; unknown unsupported. Native internal enum/coordinate normalization and MXF mixed/segmented rules are not transplanted.',
    'proxy': 'Preserve existing seven exact configurations only: complete coding, resolutionID, three sizes/layout and zero offsets. Read Sampled only when a candidate needs qualification; known ordinary valid Display survives independent Sampled damage. No blanket Stored fallback for an unexplained crop, small raster or H264 family.',
    'retentionAndDisplay': 'Selected numeric width/height with compact origin/availability as needed; current widthxheight late display/export and numeric pair sort. Audio and unavailable picture blank, physical row/independent valid fields retained. No duplicate formatted row label/raw property graph.',
    'implementation': 'Small fresh typed OMF adapter/shared ordinary checked geometry functions; explicit MDB/OMF vs MXF coordinate/default adapters. std::optional and fixed-width integers suffice, validated QSize only at int-compatible boundary with positive dimensions checked. No class/parser per column, hierarchy, floating-point/aspect scaling or new dependency.',
    'compressionAndLifetime': 'Approved Compression stored naming geometry/clock unchanged and separate from visible Resolution. Share needed temporary facts; release rectangles/indexes/bytes when all agreed consumers finish, keep only selected values/required compact context.',
    'otherDecisions': 'No new file opens, essence decode, source preference/cancel/scheduling decision, native GUI equivalence or measured gain. Final priority/opening rules and general OMF damage handling remain later.',
}
out = {
    'schemaVersion': 1, 'date': '2026-10-25', 'timezone': 'Australia/Sydney',
    'status': rules['status'],
    'currentHead': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip(),
    'compressionApproval': record(approval_path),
    'proposedBellaRules': rules,
    'publicPrimaryEvidence': [
        {'title': 'Avid OMF Interchange Specification2.1 DIDD', 'url': 'https://www.cubase.it/wp/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/omfspec21.pdf#page=146', 'checked': '2026-10-25', 'scope': 'Stored-relative rectangle offsets/defaults and strict complete-set model; modern schema is not legacy wire-type proof or new OMF2 support.'},
        {'title': 'Original OMF toolkit CDCI reader', 'url': 'https://github.com/LWKS-Software/omfkt22/blob/main/kitomfi/omcCDCI.c', 'checked': '2026-10-25', 'scope': 'Legacy per-field geometry compatibility; preserve established current rules with absence distinguished from read damage.'},
        {'title': 'Qt6.5 QSize', 'url': 'https://doc.qt.io/qt-6.5/qsize.html#isValid', 'checked': '2026-10-25', 'scope': 'Integer presentation type; isValid includes zero and does not replace positive/range validation.'},
    ],
    'receiptFiles': receipt_files, 'nativeAndCurrentReceipts': receipts,
    'artifactTextCaptures': captures,
    'reusedOwnMetadata': {'sourceReceipts': current['reusedActualExamples']['sourceReceipts'],
                          'examples': examples, 'rootNumericChecks': numeric_checks,
                          'boundary': 'Five saved qualified paths, three picture crops and two audio. No fresh media read, app cell, production parser, absent-value/proxy/layout3/damaged physical specimen claimed.'},
    'rootCurationProgram': {**record(__file__), 'source': Path(__file__).read_text()},
    'rootVerification': {'referencedFilesRehashed': verified,
                         'unavailableHistoricalRawReferences': historical,
                         'unavailableFreshInputs': fresh_unavailable,
                         'mdvxCodeRangesRehashed': ranges,
                         'nativeExtantRawArtifactsRehashed': 13, 'freshDisassembly': False,
                         'sourceFilesEqualHead': 12, 'sourceAnchorHashesVerified': 28,
                         'reusedPhysicalPaths': 5, 'freshPhysicalMediaReads': 0,
                         'nativeAppsOrPrivateApisExecuted': False, 'productionParserExecuted': False,
                         'runtimeCodeChanged': False, 'testsOrBuildsExecuted': False, 'performanceMeasured': False},
    'independentDraftReviews': {'native': 'Passed; typed/default/normalization and TIFF/nativeGUI boundaries correct.',
                                'mdvx': 'Passed; physical-raster omission distinct from ID naming and library/browser capabilities.',
                                'currentSource': 'Passed; source defaults/layout, selective Sampled/proxy, numeric result, independent Compression and real/authored test boundaries correct.'},
    'limits': ['Reuse-only native review; same installed binary and extant artifacts freshly hashed, older unavailable raw paths explicitly historical. No fresh broad native/GUI decompilation claimed.',
               'MDVx bounded generic item/table/string inventory omission is not a universal no-geometry claim for all libraries/browser facilities. Standalone physical OMF fallback unestablished.',
               'Existing pure geometry helper already compact; proposed simplification is selective typed reading, numeric storage and short temporary lifetimes. No measured speed/memory/stability improvement.',
               'Three saved II own picture examples establish crop/field arithmetic, not exhaustive layouts/defaults/proxy/damage/writer coverage. Direct OmfReader/MDB geometry matrices are authored and inspected only.',
               'Current generic type conversion/coarse completeness/string sort narrowing are static limits; no bad actual current Resolution cell asserted.',
               'TIFF native Summary/IFD separate; no new decoder/unsupported fallback, table column, file opening or source scheduling decision. Compression accepted rules unchanged.']
}
destination = ROOT / 'Project Bella/evidence/omf-resolution-2026-10-25.json'
destination.write_text(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'evidence': str(destination), 'bytes': destination.stat().st_size,
                  'referencedFilesRehashed': len(verified), 'textCaptures': len(captures),
                  'historicalRawUnavailable': len(historical), 'sourceInputs': 12, 'sourceAnchors': 28,
                  'mdvxCodeRanges': len(ranges), 'freshDisassembly': False,
                  'freshMediaReads': 0, 'reusedPictureResults': [v['selectedNumericRaster'] for v in numeric_checks]}))
